body:
Validated Verlet/PBD ragdoll approach on the real 65-joint mannequin_npc.gskel at SHANKPIT's real 64Hz tick rate. Found+fixed two real bugs (Verlet ground-clamp velocity spike, distance-constraint sign error for body B). Result: numerically stable, converges by t=0.5s, but collapses flat -- angular/joint-limit constraints are the real next requirement, not per-bone collision/mass. SHANKPIT 3fdbe30.

⚓ ☃
title: PBD ragdoll spike on real mannequin skeleton (S484)
